title: Run full FP8/INT8 benchmark matrix on H100 + A100 for top 6 hosted models (suite v3)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal
Run the full benchmark matrix (microbench + end-to-end serving) on H100 and A100 across the top 6 hosted models using Benchmark Suite v3. Upload artifacts with the required metadata (git SHA, container/driver/CUDA, clocks, model hash, config), and obtain review sign-off from Runtime Kernel + Scheduling + Evals.

Scope / what “full matrix” means for this ticket
- GPUs: H100 SXM (primary), A100 80GB (primary)
- Models: top 6 hosted models per Eng + Applied ML sign-off (see link below)
- Kernel modes: baseline (current prod), FP8 variant, INT8 variant (where supported per model + shape guardrails)
- Workloads (Suite v3):
  - Prefill-heavy (short gen) distribution
  - Decode-heavy (long gen) distribution
  - Mixed prefill/decode distribution w/ concurrency
  - Tool-calling / structured output variant (where suite defines it)
- Metrics captured per run: TTFT p50/p95, TPOT p50/p95, tokens/sec, request/sec (where meaningful), GPU util, GPU mem peak, error rate, variance / confidence bounds.

Links / source of truth
- Sprint plan (Confluence): sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/benchmarking-and-perf-suite/fp8-int8-kernel-benchmarking-sprint-plan.json
- Methodology (Confluence): sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/kernel-and-scheduling/kernel-benchmarking-methodology-top-hosted-models.json
- Benchmark suite v3 definition (Confluence): sources/confluence/applied-ml-and-evals/prompt-sets-and-benchmarks/top-hosted-models-benchmark-suite-v3.json
- Working benchmark matrix (Drive): sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime/fp8-int8-benchmark-matrix-v1.json
- Runner/aggregation PRs: 
  - sources/github/benchmark-lab/pr-842-add-matrix-runner-h100-a100-and-result-aggregation.json
  - sources/github/benchmark-lab/pr-851-pin-driver-cuda-and-gpu-clocks-in-runner.json
- Runtime harness artifact metadata PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-19880-add-benchmark-artifact-uploader-and-metadata.json

Execution plan
1) Reserve capacity
- Confirm reservation windows with Infra (Irene Choi / Vanessa Ortiz); avoid Dedicated pool collisions.
- Verify cluster images match pinned driver/CUDA (runner enforces, but spot-check nodes).

2) Environment pinning + reproducibility checklist (per methodology)
- Container image digest recorded
- CUDA + driver recorded
- GPU clocks locked (or explicitly recorded as “unlocked”)
- MIG/partitioning off unless explicitly part of test
- Warmup: follow suite defaults; discard warmup samples
- Run count: meet minimum N per case + stability criterion (variance threshold)

3) Run matrix
- Use matrix runner for both H100 and A100.
- Run baseline first, then FP8, then INT8, to reduce confusion during anomaly triage.
- If a case fails correctness or guardrails, record as “unsupported” and capture logs + fallback mode.

4) Upload artifacts + populate matrix sheet
- Upload raw JSON/CSV outputs, runner logs, and (for flagged top 3 anomalies) Nsight traces.
- Ensure each artifact includes: git SHA, benchmark runner SHA, runtime SHA, model identifier + hash, kernel mode, scheduling config, suite version, region/cluster, instance type, driver/CUDA, clocks.
- Add notes for anomalies (e.g., throttling, noisy neighbor, retry) directly in the matrix sheet.

5) Review + sign-off
- Kernel review: Hiro Tanaka + Grace Kim (spot-check shape coverage, confirm FP8/INT8 modes reflect intended flags)
- Scheduling review: Sofia Ivanova + Omar El-Sayed (confirm mixed workload results align with scheduler instrumentation)
- Evals/quality acknowledgement: Jonas Weber or Arjun Desai (confirm any quality caveats are tagged for downstream policy)

Acceptance criteria (Definition of Done)
- [x] H100: completed runs for all 6 models across all Suite v3 workloads for baseline + FP8 + INT8 where supported.
- [x] A100: completed runs for all 6 models across all Suite v3 workloads for baseline + FP8 + INT8 where supported.
- [x] All outputs uploaded with required metadata; matrix sheet updated with links to artifacts.
- [x] Variance within standards or explicitly documented with reruns + root-cause notes.
- [x] Review sign-off captured in ticket comments (Kernel + Scheduling + Evals).

Notes / known pitfalls
- Watch for thermal throttling on long decode runs; compare GPU clocks telemetry to expected locked range.
- Driver mismatch across clusters can silently skew results; runner pinning helps but still validate.
- Debug logging paths can perturb results (see ENG-??? / PR-19918); ensure benchmark config disables verbose logs.

Artifacts (uploaded)
- Drive folder (raw outputs + logs): uploaded under “engineering/serving-runtime/fp8-int8/benchmarks/2026-02-matrix-h100-a100/” (see matrix sheet links).
- Nsight traces: captured for 3 anomaly cases (H100 FP8 TTFT regression case; A100 INT8 decode variance case; mixed workload backpressure spike case).
comments: 2026-02-12 (Isabella Rossi): Capacity confirmed with Irene/Vanessa for H100 (us-east, eu-west) and A100 (us-east). Runner pinned to CUDA/driver combo per PR-851; will start with baseline runs tonight. Matrix sheet initialized with tabs for H100/A100 + suite v3 workload columns.

2026-02-14 (Isabella Rossi): H100 baseline complete for 6/6 models across prefill-heavy + decode-heavy. Mixed workload shows higher variance on two models (p95 TPOT swings ~6–9%). Rerunning with clocks locked + isolated nodes; suspect contention / thermal. Uploaded raw outputs + runner logs for completed cases; links in matrix sheet.

2026-02-16 (Julian Moore): Verified scheduler instrumentation present in all end-to-end runs (prefill/decode split histograms + queue depth). For reruns, please keep the same scheduler config file and only change node placement/clocks to isolate variance causes.

2026-02-18 (Isabella Rossi): H100 FP8 + INT8 runs complete for all supported cases. Two INT8 cases hit shape guardrails (recorded as unsupported; baseline fallback verified). Captured Nsight trace for FP8 TTFT regression case; trace uploaded and linked in matrix notes.

2026-02-20 (Isabella Rossi): A100 matrix complete (baseline/FP8/INT8 where supported). One A100 decode-heavy case had thermal throttling (clocks drifted); rerun on fresh node with locked clocks resolved variance. All artifacts uploaded with metadata (runtime SHA, runner SHA, driver/CUDA, clocks).

2026-02-21 (Grace Kim): Kernel sign-off: reviewed a sample of FP8/INT8 cases on H100 + A100. Shape coverage matches expected top-suite regimes; unsupported INT8 cases correctly fall back. Nsight trace for TTFT regression indicates launch overhead sensitivity; recommend combining with scheduler tuning notes before enabling default.

2026-02-22 (Omar El-Sayed): Scheduling sign-off: mixed workload results consistent with queue depth/backpressure counters. Where FP8 wins shrink end-to-end, it correlates with tighter batching window; please ensure these cases are called out for ENG-7429/PR-19911 follow-up.

2026-02-24 (Jonas Weber): Evals acknowledgement: for two models, INT8 shows minor quality delta on long-context prompts in suite v3; acceptable behind flag with eval-gated default policy. Please tag these in the matrix and link to quality summary for Arjun/Priyanka. OK to close execution ticket; analysis/decision captured in ADR/next tickets.
